The vertical axis runs from about 1,000 at the bottom to 4,500 near the top, with labeled ticks at 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000, 3,500, and 4,500.
The Tue stack top is slightly above the 4,500 gridline, around 4,650; its blue/green boundary is near 1,300 and green/orange boundary near 3,300.
The Wed stack top is just above the 4,500 gridline, around 4,550; its blue/green boundary is near 1,350 and green/orange boundary near 2,650.
The Thu stack top is between the 4,000 and 4,500 gridlines, around 4,150; its blue/green boundary is near 1,100 and green/orange boundary near 2,650.
The Mon stack top is just below the 4,000 gridline, around 3,900; its blue/green boundary is near 1,350 and green/orange boundary near 2,800.
Legend swatches show Station X as blue, Station Y as green, and Station Z as orange.
